{{Youmay|[[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] ranks|[[military rank]]s, the [[Foodstuff/Legends|food product]] "[[Rank (food)|Rank]]," or [[the Rank]], an [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Death/Legends|dead]] zone}}
[[File:TanDivo-SWE.png|thumb|right|180px|A Coruscant Security Force lieutenant in full uniform.]]
'''Police rank''' was the established order of commanding responsibility between the various [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] of a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]]. In many cases the ranks were similar to [[Military rank/Legends|military ranks]].

==Examples==
===Corellian Security Force===
{{Main|Corellian Security Force}}
After graduating and performing well in the field, CorSec police officers could be promoted to [[Master Sergeant/Legends|Master Sergeant]],<ref name="CorSecMSarg">''{{SWGTCG|set=Agents of Deception|cardname=CorSec Master Sergeant}}''</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]],<ref name="card">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Mack Jasper}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]],<ref name="Card">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Vitala Baize}}</ref> and [[Major/Legends|Major]].<ref name="CorSecMajor">''{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|cardname=CorSec Major}}''</ref> CorSec was headed by a [[Director/Legends|Director]].<ref name="IJedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref> Officers could also become [[Inspector/Legends|CorSec Inspectors]] in they wanted to perform purely investigative work.<ref name="CorSecInvst">''{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=CorSec Investigator}}''</ref> During the time of the Galactic Empire, the organization was observed by an [[Imperial Liaison]] officer.
<ref name="MCJ7">''{{JournalCite|7|Missed Chance}}''</ref>

===Coruscant Security Force===
{{Main|Coruscant Security Force/Legends}}
During the days of the Galactic Republic, CSF police officers were sometimes referred to as [[Republic Peace Officer]]s.<ref name="SWR28">[[Star Wars (1998) 28|''Star Wars'' (1998) 28]]</ref> As to rank, [[Officer/Legends|Officer]]<ref name="maul">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> or [[Constable/Legends|Constable]] was the lowest,<ref name="hnn49sithbread">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|life/13328_2.html|Area Woman Finds Sith Icon in Pastebread}}</ref> then [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]],<ref name="Inv">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> [[Detective/Legends|Detective]],<ref name="Temp">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref> [[Chief of Detectives]],<ref name="Temp" /> Lieutenant,<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref> then Captain. The CSF was lead by the [[Coruscant Security Force Senior Command|CSF Senior Command]]<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref> and briefly during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]].<ref name="Betrayal 1">[[Empire 1|''Empire'' 1]]</ref> Other titles included [[Incident commander]]<ref name="Omega Squad: Targets">{{InsiderCite|81|Omega Squad: Targets}}</ref> and [[Scenes of Crimes Officer]].<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" />

===Senate Guard===
{{Main|Senate Guard/Legends}}
Although the Senate Guard of the Galactic Republic organized along the lines of a military force, its responsiblity were protection and police services. The Senate Guard was headed by a [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]].<ref name="Senate Guard">''{{DB|organization|senateguard|Senate Guard}}''</ref> A [[Sergeant-at-Arms/Legends|Sergeant at Arms]] was in charge of security in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]].<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> Beneath them were Captains,<ref name="GAW" /> then [[Commander/Legends|Commanders]] who would lead a small detachment of 6 to 10 Guards,<ref name="Senate Guard" /> then Lieutenants, then [[Private/Legends|Privates]].<ref name="GAW" />
